limits: Prior accepted recorded source summaries, not new source log scans or optimizer tensor reloads.
Historical infra/runtime and initialization conditions differ; observed timing ratio is not a causal algorithm speedup.
Native stage timers overlap; do not sum them. Rolling save outside native step is not included.
GPU-hour proxy is world_size*recorded_step_wall/3600, not GPU busy time or billed allocation.
Emitted tokens include padding/discarded tails; not effective selected policy tokens.
Historical discarded/reworked A outers are excluded; this is final-ancestry prefix cost, not all physical resource consumption.
Only five outers/single seed and aggregate EM; no paired or long-run superiority conclusion.
